assumptions.note: geometry read as height above the WGS84 ellipsoid; barometric_height_m carried unconverted

assumptions: Receiver positions are the run's ECI truth rotated to Earth-fixed by GMST (UT1 taken as UTC, no polar motion) and converted with Bowring's closed-form latitude: the same frame policy the RF kernel used for the path.
Emitter sites are the declared WGS84 geodetic sites; height is above the ellipsoid, not the geoid.
Link verdicts, ranges, elevations, losses and powers are the RF kernel's rows, copied, not recomputed.
A row exists only at a stored epoch of the run's environment; nothing is interpolated between epochs.
There is no uncertainty model: positions and powers are point values with no sigma.
simulation.rf.links.attribution: Foundation RF simulation (intelpayloads/dataforge-plugin-foundation), completed-run contract dataforge.completed-simulation-run/1 with a dataforge.rf-link-geometry/1 artifact (GEN-303). SIMULATED, not observed: the geometry is a LineString [site, receiver] in WGS84 lon/lat with heights in m above the ellipsoid. range_m in m, elevation_deg in deg, free_space_loss_db in dB, received_power_w in W (0 when the path does not reach, null when EIRP is unknown). reason is one of free_space, diffracted, inactive, earth_occulted, below_horizon_mask, zero_eirp, unknown_eirp. On a run whose terrain pins a lidar surface (GEN-404), each path also carries its ITU-R P.526 knife-edge record: obstruction_loss_db in dB, obstructed, the edge count, and the main edge's lon/lat (deg), top and ground under it (m above the ellipsoid), edge_roofed (the lidar surface set the top: a building or tree) and nu; the header's obstruction names the model and surface pin. A free-space run leaves them null

inputs.ground_height_datum: NAVD88 orthometric metres, as USGS states for every 3DEP DEM (the GeoTIFF's CRS has no vertical part); GEOID18 (world.terrain.geoid18) takes them to the NAD83(2011) ellipsoid
inputs.surface_height_datum: NAVD88 orthometric metres, as the 3DEP 1 m DEM's: the EPT's srs states no vertical datum, so it was measured -- 823,384 class-2 returns over cs-downtown sit 0.000 m (median, IQR 0.028 m) from the DEM's cells (2026-11-01). GEOID18 (world.terrain.geoid18) takes them to the NAD83(2011) ellipsoid

surface.height_datum: NAD83(2011) ellipsoid metres: h = H + N, H the highest of the 1 m lidar surface and every 1 m DEM file (NAVD88) in the cell holding the point and N GEOID18's, bilinear; used as WGS84 ellipsoid metres, about 1 m off in CONUS, not corrected

simulation.rf.links.height_datum: each vertex's third coordinate is Foundation's height above the WGS84 ellipsoid: the site's declared height, and the receiver's from the run's ECI truth by GMST (UT1 taken as UTC, no polar motion) and Bowring's latitude

active.meaning: The emitter was radiating at this epoch.

edge_nu.meaning: The main edge's diffraction parameter nu (ITU-R P.526); null when clear.

obstructed.meaning: Some obstacle edge has nu > -0.78, so the path is diffracted; null when occulted.

edge_roofed.meaning: The lidar surface set the main edge's top, so a building or tree; false when it is bare earth; null when clear.

edge_lat_deg.meaning: Latitude of the main edge; null when clear.

edge_lon_deg.meaning: Longitude of the main edge (the path's largest nu); null when clear.

edge_height_m.meaning: Height of the main edge's obstacle top above the WGS84 ellipsoid; null when clear.

elevation_deg.meaning: Geodetic elevation of the receiver seen from the site.

earth_occulted.meaning: The straight path touches the WGS84 ellipsoid.

reaches_receiver.meaning: Active, not occulted by the ellipsoid and at or above the mask: the path delivers interference.

received_power_w.meaning: Interference power this path delivers; 0 when it does not reach; null when EIRP is unknown.

obstruction_edges.meaning: Number of edges in obstruction_loss_db, 0 to 3.

below_horizon_mask.meaning: Geodetic elevation at the site is below the declared mask.

free_space_loss_db.meaning: Free-space path loss over range_m at the declared frequency.

obstruction_loss_db.meaning: Knife-edge diffraction loss over the obstacle surface (up to three Deygout edges), on top of free_space_loss_db; 0 when clear; null when the path is occulted by the ellipsoid.

edge_ground_height_m.meaning: The bare earth under the main edge (its 1 m DEM cell plus GEOID18) above the WGS84 ellipsoid; null when clear or when no DEM file holds the cell.

simulation.rf.links.valid_time_basis: the row's epoch on the run's UTC time grid, an ISO-8601 instant with its offset
